title: WinQuake 1.00 — id Software, Quake for Windows 95 and NT
author: id Software
notes: id Software's native Windows Quake, released on 21 March 1997 (wq100.zip, from id's own FTP), with the shareware episode's data (quake106.zip). The executable as id built it: Visual C++'s runtime, SciTech MGL linked in, DirectSound, Winsock. MIRAGE-WIN32 answers its Win32 calls in JavaScript, with no Windows: its software renderer draws through SciTech MGL into DirectDraw surfaces, full screen at 320x200 by default (Options, Video Options: other DirectDraw modes, or the windowed ones, an 8-bit DIB section StretchBlt puts on the screen), its sound goes through DirectSound, and Winsock reports a machine with no network, so it plays alone. Click the picture to capture the mouse.
